name: Two-Hour Escape
description: Choose Halifax or Langley, pick how much time you have, and find a short outdoor detour with a plan you can take along.
intro: Your time budget starts when you arrive. Choose a region and a visit length to find a walk that fits.

name: Rainy Saturday
description: Build a rainy-day plan around a library, gallery or museum in Halifax or Langley, with a free indoor backup.
intro: Pick a region and an admission preference. Open a venue card for a small challenge to try while you’re there.

name: Game Night Under $15 CAD
description: Find a PC game for tonight by mood or player count, with Canadian Steam prices and a sale-only filter.
intro: Choose the kind of evening you want. Prices are in Canadian dollars before tax, for the base game on Steam Canada.

name: Canadian Finds Under $50
description: Pick a Canadian shop find for a snack lover, tinkerer or tabletop fan and build a gift shortlist within your budget.
intro: Mix a snack, a tabletop pick or an electronics kit. Add items to a shortlist to see your estimated total before tax and shipping.
